summary: Proposal Phase 1 — Task 5a (MIGRATION half). Adds the canonical pure calculator public.generate_vat_periods(text, integer, date, date) RETURNS TABLE(period_start date, period_end date, period_label text). STABLE, SET search_path='public', reads no tables and writes no rows.

problem.context: Proposal Phase 1 needs per-period VAT lines/jobs. UK VAT stagger arithmetic must live in one authoritative DB function.
problem.uk_vat_rules: quarterly stagger 1 → Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec; stagger 2 → Apr/Jul/Oct/Jan; stagger 3 → May/Aug/Nov/Feb. monthly → 12/yr. annual/annual_accounting → one period ending at p_stagger month-end (1..12).

expected_objects.object: function public.generate_vat_periods(text, integer, date, date) exists as STABLE pure calculator
expected_objects.evidence: pg_proc: provolatile='s' (STABLE), proconfig={search_path=public}. Body contains no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.

expected_objects.object: quarterly stagger 1 over full CY yields 4 periods ending Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec
monthly over full CY yields 12 periods
annual and annual_accounting over full CY yield exactly 1 period ending at p_stagger month-end
expected_objects.evidence: generate_vat_periods('annual',3,'2025-01-01','2025-12-31') = (2024-04-01,2025-03-31,'VAT Y/E 31 Mar 2025'); alias 'annual_accounting' returns the identical row.

post_apply_followups: Task 5b (UI): CreateQuoteDialog VAT step calls generate_vat_periods to list catch-up + first-ongoing periods; each selected period → one vat_return quote_line carrying (period_start, period_end, period_label).
